basis.note: r16 Local Reconciliation is merged and coherently deployed on exact product main 613e031c648d8d5cdb4e260e74cd93f895f49872. PR #246 exact publication head faf14a43069bc55754c1a8ad84dd9ae3ca4aef31 passed POS20 run #397; GitHub Pages run #122 succeeded on r16 main; POS20 run #399 passed on that same main including its exact-head cognitive seal; Release Integration Burn-In run #379 passed both independent stateful integration journeys. Candidate B preview remains non-destructive; Candidate C remains the sole explicit backup-first destructive local Apply authority with rollback; unrelated local saves remain immutable; offline/failure paths fail closed; no new Firestore collection, broad list permission or remote write surface was introduced. Local Reconciliation has therefore completed all six MDP lifecycle stages. SSJR remains separate and zero until genuine production-two-account evidence is accepted.
